\(16\cdot\tfrac{49}{16}\cdot9=441\).

questions.q: The sum of squares of all the real solutions of the equation \(\log_{(x+1)}(2x^2+5x+3)=4-\log_{(2x+3)}(x^2+2x+1)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
\(2x^2+5x+3=(2x+3)(x+1)\). With \(t=\log_{(x+1)}(2x+3)\): \(1+t=4-\tfrac2t\Rightarrow t^2-3t+2=0\Rightarrow t=1,2\).
\(t=1\): \(x=-2\) (invalid base). \(t=2\): \(2x+3=(x+1)^2\Rightarrow x=\pm\sqrt2\); only \(x=\sqrt2\) keeps \(x+1>0\).
Sum of squares \(=2\).
